branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the traversable road.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 1:7 identifies that road through favored people.
branch_activations.activation: The destination makes the road something granted access to.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The requested object is a bestowed traversable way.
branch_activations.boundary: The road remains ordinary focus object.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative carries the request for guidance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The route is marked as a favoring destination.
branch_activations.activation: Gift and route meet as bestowed access.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Guidance is asked for as a way granted to the petitioner.
branch_activations.boundary: Gift is one contribution, not the whole focus act.

findings.title: Gift-mediated leading and sustaining
findings.claim: The 1:7 return can shift the focus road from merely geometric object toward a route entered through gift, led from ahead, and held as viable course.
findings.mechanism: Focus s-r-t passage, h-d-y leading-front, and h-d-y gift meet the people- and favor-defined route; their contact explains enabled sustained movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The road is both straight and lived: received, entered behind a front, and kept viable.
findings.containment: This is a qualified synthesis, not a surah thesis or a selection among other path readings.

epistemic.reason: Retrospective source explicitly reports the shift and all three focus facets are registered.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: geçişte gözden kaybolmak; özellikle yiyeceği yutmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, bir şeyin geçiş ve gidiş sırasında gözden kaybolmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The road noun carries passage with disappearance boundary.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 1:7 returns the road as people-defined route and closes with loss.
branch_activations.activation: The returned road is the viable course on which leading and gift operate.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The road is viable passage, not purely geometry.
branch_activations.boundary: Passage does not suppress other path readings.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative carries guidance toward the route.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The route is defined through people already associated with it.
branch_activations.activation: The people-defined route activates an advancing front.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The petitioner is led from ahead into a lived route.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal guide is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative carries the request to be brought onto a route.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 1:7 defines that route through bestowed favor.
branch_activations.activation: Favor supplies the mode by which the viable route is entered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route's enabling is received gift.
branch_activations.boundary: Gift colors the request and does not replace it.
